summary: Targeted bug-fix verification for Smart Crewing. Doc mismatch (minor): /app/memory/test_credentials.md lists +919555000111 as 'seeker with matches but NOT eligible (unlock gate)', but that account is now eligible/unlocked (contacts revealed) due to earlier test claims. Update the credentials doc or reset the account if the gate needs demoing.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Chat flow lives on route '/' (NOT '/chat'); Home renders ChatFlow in the right column. Provider step order verified: rank -> vessel -> sea_time -> sea_time_priority -> coc(multiselect, 19 options) -> coc_priority -> us_visa -> mobile -> otp -> consent -> company_name -> email -> availability -> availability_priority -> review. Auth endpoints are /api/auth/request-otp and /api/auth/verify-otp (no /send-otp). There is no GET /api/provider/requirement; provider requirement is echoed inside GET /api/matches under 'requirement'. Reusable test file: /app/backend/tests/test_bugfix_usvisa.py.
rca_of_the_issue: Both reported bugs are fixed at source: buildProviderSteps() in ChatFlow.jsx no longer contains the us_visa_priority step, and the multiselect Confirm handler passes the label 'Any of the following N countries: ...'. Matches.jsx no longer passes a tag to the seeker card US Visa Field. Backend ProviderRequirement.us_visa_priority is Optional with default 'Preferred', so payloads without it are accepted.
